headline: What Is Going on With Intel Stock on Wednesday?
summary: Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) stock gained over 2% premarket on Wednesday after the tech giant achieved a major milestone, becoming the first chipmaker to deploy ASML's highly advanced High-NA EUV system for laptop processor manufacturing.

headline: Jim Cramer: Intel Is My No. 1 Stock — And ASML’s No. 3 Customer
summary: Jim Cramer ties his top stock pick, Intel, to ASML's AI spending boom, highlighting Intel's role as a top customer.

headline: Intel Has Reached ‘Very Important Milestone’ With Its $400 Million Chipmaking Machine, ASML CEO Says
summary: Intel is already shipping chips made with its most advanced chipmaking machine, marking a "milestone" says ASML CEO.
